Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.model

Class ScenarioComparison

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.model.ScenarioComparison
public class ScenarioComparison extends Object
US-28: a scenario's score next to the household's current score. Scores are rounded to one decimal place, as displayed, so the difference always matches the two scores shown beside it.
